title: Go-decision matrix and milestone compression plan for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Diego Martins
description: Objective: compress the release train timeline by 2 weeks while preserving quality signals and giving clear go/no-go thresholds across API, Console, and Runtime. Outcome: a single go-decision matrix that product, eng, design, security, and GTM can use for consistent scope locks and rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Documented go/no-go matrix accepted by ENG Lead, Design Lead, and Security by 2026-03-12
Compressed milestone calendar published to the release calendar and synced with PMO
Cut criteria provide numeric thresholds (latency, error-rate, e2e smoke success, regressions) and a clear owner for each signal
Release notes template and comms checklist created and linked for each milestone (Beta/RC/GA)
Fallback plan documented (model-variant and region-based) with owners and steps
cut_criteria: Performance: 95th percentile token-latency for typical 512-token requests < 120ms on dedicated profile
Reliability: Service error rate < 0.5% sustained over 24h on production-like load
Regression: No more than 2 customer-facing prompt regressions vs baseline eval set; critical regressions must be zero
Security: SSO/SAML end-to-end smoke + KMS integration test green
Observability: Console dashboards for per-route token cost, 95/50 latency, and error-rate are populated and validated
Docs/Release notes: Release notes draft for GA and Beta published and reviewed by comms
risks: Kernel regressions on new quantized runtime path could increase tail latency
Dedicated capacity autoscaler edge case under burst traffic may cause transient throttling
Cross-team bandwidth during compressed window (design + infra) could delay fixes
Security review and customer audit delays if KMS/HSM integration issues surface
comments: 2026-03-02 Diego Martins: Kickoff sync completed with Eng, Design, Security. Agreed to target 2-week compression; Eng asked for a clear performance SLA to work toward.
